recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast cinematic composition featuring two men in 1970s-style outerwear emerging from deep shadows next to a brick wall, framed by a dominant black background and wide-tracked serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject emerging from shadow into a soft spotlight
Contrast between the warm tones of the clothing/brick and the cold black void
Extreme horizontal letter spacing creating a sense of tension and scale
coreInvariants: Deep black negative space occupying at least 60% of the frame
Chiaroscuro lighting with harsh shadows and soft highlights
Muted, desaturated earth tones in the photographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects positioned in the lower-left quadrant, scaled to approximately 40% height, appearing to walk toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The primary figure in the foreground wearing a textured, light-colored coat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-center title, moves down to the subjects, then follows the vertical list of names on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space surrounds the subjects and text, focusing attention on the central action and typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in imagery; high value contrast between black background and white/red text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to black, red, white, and desaturated browns

letterConstructionRules: Wide proportions with sharp, bracketed serifs
High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
Extreme letter-spacing (tracking) for all display elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard high-contrast serif skeletons
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic serif family using color and scale to differentiate hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, small-serif aesthetic of the metadata text.
Provides the high-contrast drama needed for the main title.
Matches the wide, formal, and sharp serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic photograph of two men in 1970s trench coats and sunglasses emerging from a dark alleyway next to a brown brick wall. The lighting is high-contrast chiaroscuro, with the right side of the frame fading into pure black. Muted earth tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large uppercase title in red with extreme tracking at the top. Add a vertical list of names in white, small-caps, also with wide tracking, aligned to the right side of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking on all text extremely wide?
Is the background primarily solid black?
Are the subjects lit with a dramatic spotlight effect?
Is the main title red and the secondary text white?

adjustableVariables: Degree of tracking in the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the actors

avoid: Bright, saturated colors other than red

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subjects
Check that the brick texture is visible but not distracting
Verify the red title is the clear visual anchor
Confirm the tracking is consistent across all text elements
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast noir photograph with wide-tracked, high-contrast serif typography in red and white against a black void.
